stories.title: Consent Tier Enforcement Core Logic
stories.description: Implement core backend logic enforcing Tier 1 vs Tier 2 consent rules, including gating of identifiable data storage, upgrade transitions, and rejection of invalid state transitions.

stories.title: De-identification and Conversation Summarization Pipeline
stories.description: Integrate de-identification and summarization pipeline to ensure all Tier 1 data is stripped of PHI using HIPAA Safe Harbor rules and summarized before persistence.

stories.title: Consent Integration with Lead Capture Service
stories.description: Integrate consent workflow with lead capture service to enforce Tier 2 requirement for identifiable lead storage, including duplicate detection and consent validation before write.
